name: Find Love 2: The Prologue
source:
Main character finds himself in his room. There are a lot of promotional materials of new game "Find Love 2" scattered around. Among there there is a videophone device with the ability to talk remotely to three different girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公发现自己身处房间，四周散落着新游戏《Find Love 2》的宣传资料。其中有一台可与三名不同女孩远程交谈的可视电话。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
